== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[An Enemy Of The Republic (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-anenemyoftherepublic-pre.gif]]) and the Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-15-An_Enemy_Of_The_Republic.png]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the PC website card list (by 21 July 2012; the ▲ written out there). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on Sidious. While at Senate, if battle was just initiated anywhere, opponent must relocate this card to their participating non-droid character; during battle here, your destiny draws may not be canceled. If character about to be lost, relocate to Sidious; may ▲ any one card.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1250_18</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with this game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
